custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations: the test location and location B.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor; type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573673 VENDOR A in Name *, then click Save & Close.
  • Have a special-order number that location B received from vendor A on a special-order line within the last 12 months; the test location never received it and does not stock it.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573673 LINE S in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. In the line's Parts row click + Add Part, then More options; type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573673-SO in Part Number and pick Add new special order part, type a Description, 1 in Quantity, pick vendor A under Vendor and type a Cost, then click Save Part; order it and receive it from vendor A on the Receive screen (Purchase Orders in the left menu, Receive on its row, Vendor Invoice #, Invoice Date, Qty received, then the Receive Parts button).
  • Create a work order for this test at the test location, work order 1, with a line.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573673 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, then click Save & Close.
  • Create a work order for this test at location B, work order 2, with a line.
    • How to do it: Location B is Staging Lethbridge - 4310: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick it; switch back to Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 the same way. At location B: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573673 LINE 2 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, then click Save & Close.
  • Start on work order 1 (Work Orders in the top bar, then open work order 1).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Part Request" window opens on work order 1 at the test location.

Step 2:

  • No result shows "Part Library · " with vendor A's name, because the test location did not receive the number.
  • The number is offered from the shared list with the source "Part Library" alone.

Step 3:

  • The window closes.

Step 4:

  • The location selector shows location B.

Step 5:

  • Location B's Work Orders list opens.

Step 6:

  • Work order 2 opens.

Step 7:

  • The "New Part Request" window opens at location B.

Step 8:

  • At location B the number is offered with the source "Part Library · " followed by vendor A's name.

Step 9:

  • The window closes, and work order 2's line shows no new part request, nor does work order 1's.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library), story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only)

  • S12-R14a: “A special-order lookup result is a part number this location received from a vendor on a special-order line (a received line with no inventory part, and not a core) in the last 12 months.”
  • S12-R14: “A special-order lookup result shows its source as "Part Library · {vendor}".”
  • S12-R10: “A part lookup result that comes from the shared list shows its source as "Part Library".”
  • S11-R6: “A new Part Library entry is created only from a part number in use: creating an inventory part (S7-R7 and S7-R8), a part request when the requested part is received, a delivery receipt, a core charge, returning a special-order part to inventory, returning a core to inventory, the parts CSV import, and the public API.”

Partly checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026; not yet seen on that build: ordering and receiving a special-order part (the New Part Request window offered "Add new special order part" once, then "No results").
